display_long_description:
TACTICA: First Contact brings immersive VR/MR sci-fi tabletop tactics. Command an elite squad to push back an alien revolt across the colonies, as an unexpected Mech campaign ignites. The conflict widens, and a shadowy force endangers the galaxy. Your battlefield decisions could shape the future.


# Tabletop Strategy Reimagined for VR and MR:
Step into TACTICA and discover the thrill of classic tabletop gaming in an entirely new dimension. From your elevated vantage point in VR or MR, you’ll command your squad through strategic, turn-based battles where every choice impacts the outcome. Playing TACTICA in mixed reality instantly transports you back to those childhood afternoons spent orchestrating epic tabletop battles.

[media]

# Skill Card System
TACTICA’s unique skill card system shapes your squad’s combat tactics. Harness a mix of offensive and defensive skill cards to outmaneuver foes and unleash devastating attacks. 
[media]
# Story Campaign
In TACTICA: First Contact, the galaxy teeters on collapse. Human expansion has sparked an alien revolt in the colonies, and as captain, you must suppress the uprising. But as the war unfolds, a covert Mech faction emerges—threatening not just the colonies but the entire Solar System. Stop the rebellion and confront this looming force head-on.
